free_tier.stated: FREE TIER IS 1,000 ITEMS, NOT 1 TB. The famous 1 TB was killed on 2019-01-08. Free = 1,000 photos/videos total, of which max 50 may be non-public. Pro (paid) = unlimited storage, full-res, no monthly cap.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered for public images (staticflickr.com CDN). Non-public content on free accounts is capped at 50 and at risk of deletion, so egress is real only for public photos.

tooling: Flickr API (OAuth1), flickr-sync; no native rclone backend; ShareX and Lightroom publish plugins.
chaining: Unlimited free accounts x 1,000 items. This is a per-record cap, not a byte cap — but 1,000 items x 200 MB max = ~200 GB/account at absolute best, and item 1,001 is deleted.
limits_note: 1,000 items; 50 non-public items; free accounts limited to Safe content and no commercial use.
reliability_note: Enforcement is real and documented: over-limit accounts are suspended or have content deleted. Pro is required for any bulk use.

evidence.proved: 'Store more than 50 Non-Public photos or videos'; 'Upload over 1,000 items'; 'Content that exceeds these limits is at risk of suspension or deletion'
